about.name: University of New Hampshire Water Balance Model Ancillary Data
about.description: The University of New Hampshire Water Balance Model Ancillary Data for use with the WBM Open Source Release Version 1.0: the same global ancillary dataset the WBM model draws its non-forcing inputs from as v2.0.0's data_init records (crop calendars and coefficients (MIRCA2000), glacier area and discharge (RGI-6, ERA-Interim hindcast), irrigation efficiency, dam capacity, and harmonized soil available water capacity), carried in the tree staged for the Wyoming_tracking and Global_tracking v1.0.0 snapshots.
